```{=html}
<div class="va-cv-actions">
  <a class="va-cv-download" href="CV-eng.pdf" hreflang="en" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    Download CV (English) <i class="fa-solid fa-file-arrow-down"></i>
  </a>
  <a class="va-cv-download is-secondary" href="CV-esp.pdf" lang="es" hreflang="es" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    Descargar CV (Español) <i class="fa-solid fa-file-arrow-down"></i>
  </a>
</div>

<!-- Chooses which PDF the preview below shows. Hidden until the script at the
     bottom runs, so without JS there is no dead control: the preview stays on
     English and both download buttons above still work. -->
<div class="va-cv-switch" role="group" aria-label="Preview language" hidden>
  <span class="lbl">Preview:</span>
  <button type="button" data-cv="CV-eng.pdf" data-title="Curriculum Vitae (English)" aria-pressed="true">English</button>
  <span class="dot" aria-hidden="true">·</span>
  <button type="button" lang="es" data-cv="CV-esp.pdf" data-title="Curriculum Vitae (Español)" aria-pressed="false">Español</button>
</div>

<div class="va-cv-frame">
  <iframe src="CV-eng.pdf" title="Curriculum Vitae (English)"></iframe>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var sw = document.querySelector('.va-cv-switch');
  var frame = document.querySelector('.va-cv-frame');
  if (!sw || !frame) return;
  var buttons = sw.querySelectorAll('button[data-cv]');

  function show(btn) {
    // Swap in a fresh iframe instead of changing `src`: navigating an existing
    // iframe adds a history entry, so the browser's Back button would flip the
    // preview back rather than leave the page.
    var next = document.createElement('iframe');
    next.src = btn.dataset.cv;
    next.title = btn.dataset.title;
    frame.querySelector('iframe').replaceWith(next);
    buttons.forEach(function (b) {
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b === btn ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  buttons.forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true') show(b);
    });
  });
  sw.hidden = false;
})();
</script>
```
